calls.title: PostNord & Growthbook Proposal
calls.summary: The discussion explored the complex decision-making structure at PostNord concerning the adoption of Growthbook, highlighting the roles of the Customer Solutions and Production Divisions. Currently, 27 Growthbook seats are in use, with plans to scale to over 100, particularly focusing on onboarding flow experiments. Pricing concerns arose regarding the proposed Enterprise license at $200,000 annually, which is perceived as expensive compared to the existing self-hosted version. A one-month proof of concept is proposed to showcase Growthbook’s ROI related to key performance indicators. Additionally, technical requirements such as SSO integration and advanced experimental features, like sticky bucketing, are crucial for any potential deployment.
calls.keywords: Growthbook, PostNord, Experimentation, Onboarding, Procurement, ROI
